steps.name: Install dependencies (own package manager — literal detect_pm ladder below)
steps.run:
set -e
# ownPM selection — the detect_pm ladder verbatim (lib.sh:2460-2474, sha 3ce99cf9…).
# Workflow cwd is GITHUB_WORKSPACE = repo root = the $PROJECT_ROOT detect_pm reads.
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] || [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then PM=pnpm
elif [ -f yarn.lock ] || [ -f .yarnrc.yml ]; then PM=yarn
else PM=npm
fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f package.json ]; then
  field=$(AIF_PJ=package.json node -e 'try{const m=(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.env.AIF_PJ,"utf8")).packageManager||"").split("@")[0];if(["npm","pnpm","yarn"].includes(m))process.stdout.write(m)}catch{}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$field" ] && PM="$field"
fi
echo "getff: own package manager selected: $PM"
# Install with the SELECTED own PM only — its own lock/no-lock policy. NO cross-PM
# fallback anywhere: an unavailable tool fails this step loudly (set -e), it never
# silently installs via another manager.
case "$PM" in
  pnpm)
    corepack enable
    if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else pnpm install; fi ;;
  yarn)
    corepack enable
    # Modern Yarn defaults immutable=TRUE under CI (yarnpkg.com/cli/install) and then
    # aborts when resolution must create a lockfile. No-lock installs therefore carry
    # an EXPLICIT non-immutable flag (the negation of that same documented setting);
    # lock-present installs stay immutable via the --frozen-lockfile alias.
    if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --frozen-lockfile; else yarn install --no-immutable; fi ;;
  npm)
    if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --prefer-offline; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi ;;
esac

steps.name: Stryker on diff only
steps.run:
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only "origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF...HEAD" \
  | grep -E '^src/.+\.(ts|tsx)$' \
  | grep -v -E '\.(unit|integration|audit|e2e|test|spec|stories)\.(ts|tsx)$' \
  | tr '\n' ',' || true)
if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then
  npx stryker run --mutate "$CHANGED" --incremental
else
  echo "No src/ changes — skipping Stryker"
fi

        "${{ needs.typecheck.result }}" \

steps.name: Assert ci-success is a required status check on the default branch
steps.run:
# Tri-state semantics:
#   - protection or rulesets configured AND include ci-success → pass
#   - protection or rulesets configured but ci-success missing → fail (R11 violated)
#   - no protection AND no rulesets → warn, pass (not yet adopted, OR permanently
#     unavailable on a GitHub Free private repo — protection/rulesets need GitHub Pro)
# Rationale: don't block PRs in repos that haven't yet configured branch
# protection. Once configured, R11 enforcement kicks in automatically.

protection_json="$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/branches/${DEFAULT_BRANCH}/protection" 2>/dev/null || echo 'null')"
rulesets_json="$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/rulesets" 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"

has_protection=$(echo "$protection_json" | jq 'if . == null or (type=="object" and has("message")) then false else true end')
has_rulesets=$(echo "$rulesets_json" | jq 'if type=="array" then [.[] | select(.enforcement == "active")] | length > 0 else false end')

if [ "$has_protection" = "true" ]; then
  if echo "$protection_json" | jq -e '.required_status_checks.contexts | contains(["ci-success"])' > /dev/null; then
    echo "✅ ci-success is required on ${DEFAULT_BRANCH} (classic branch protection)"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "::error::Branch protection exists on ${DEFAULT_BRANCH} but ci-success is NOT in required status checks (R11 violated)."
  echo "::error::Settings → Branches → ${DEFAULT_BRANCH} → Require status checks → ci-success"
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$has_rulesets" = "true" ]; then
  echo "✅ rulesets active — manually verify ci-success in https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/settings/rules"
  exit 0
fi

echo "::warning::No branch protection or active rulesets on ${DEFAULT_BRANCH}. R11 branch-protection is not active — either not yet adopted, or unavailable on a GitHub Free private repo (classic protection and rulesets require GitHub Pro, or a public repo)."
echo "::warning::To enable (needs a public repo, or GitHub Pro/Team for private): Settings → Branches → ${DEFAULT_BRANCH} → Require status checks → ci-success"
exit 0
